transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. I'm here because I've been struggling with really painful, intrusive memories and flashbacks of a traumatic event that happened about a year and a half ago. It constantly feels like I'm reliving it, and I just can't seem to make it stop.
You mentioned this event occurred a year and a half ago; have these intrusive symptoms been present continuously since the event, or did they only begin recently?
They actually started almost immediately after it happened and have been going on continuously for about a year and five months now. It really hasn't let up at all since then.
